attempted_claim: Let P(Z^3) be lattice polytopes in R^3 and Sym^9(R^3) symmetric tensors of rank 9. Consider maps Z:P(Z^3)->Sym^9(R^3) that are valuations (inclusion-exclusion on unions/intersections in P(Z^3)), SL(3,Z)-equivariant, and translation-covariant in the McMullen--Ludwig--Silverstein sense. Via McMullen homogeneous decomposition and Ehrhart-tensor polarization, decide the exact classification formula at rank 9: prove that every such Z is a unique real linear combination of the rank-9 Ehrhart tensors and the documented exotic rank-9 equivariant translation-covariant valuation, with explicit finite basis and dimension, or disprove it by exhibiting a further independent valuation. A complete answer is a full proof of the stated basis/dimension formula or a rigorously verified valuation outside that span with equivariance, valuation property, and linear-independence proofs.
decisive_failure: Finite floating-point census only: SVD ranks are numerical lower bounds, not exact dimensions; Reeve and dilate sampling cannot control infinitely many SL(3,Z) orbits; no proof of the basis/dimension formula and no new valuation were obtained, and the salvaged no-go observations were judged too routine to claim.
